task.description:
DOC-UPDATER Step 7 — finalize the ISS-0085 / GOV-01 fix.

1. Update CHANGELOG.md with a new entry under the unreleased section (or create one if missing) describing: 'ISS-0085 / GOV-01 — apply UAT scenario schema v1.1 addendum to consumer agent docs (UAT_RUNNER.md, PRODUCT_OWNER.md, ORCHESTRATOR.md §8e, WF-05_uat_run.md, WF-06_scenario_authoring.md, CLAUDE.md) so platform_workflow / company_id: platform / via: system / system_state scenarios are accepted by the runtime.'

2. Update docs/issues/ISS-0085.json:
   - status: RESOLVED
   - last_updated: current UTC
   - resolution: 'v1.1 addendum applied to UAT_RUNNER.md, PRODUCT_OWNER.md, ORCHESTRATOR.md, WF-05_uat_run.md, WF-06_scenario_authoring.md, CLAUDE.md.'
   - implemented_in: list of touched files
   - commit: ada745f0
   - resolved_by_run: WF03-GH300-20260810

3. Commit and push the bookkeeping:
   git add CHANGELOG.md docs/issues/ISS-0085.json docs/issues/issue_index.json (if updated)
   git commit -m 'docs(WF03-GH300): mark ISS-0085 / GOV-01 RESOLVED'
   git push origin feature/WF03-GH300-20260810

4. Create a GitHub pull request (gh pr create) for the branch:
   gh pr create --base main --title 'ISS-0085 / GOV-01 — Apply UAT scenario schema v1.1 addendum' --body 'See docs/issues/ISS-0085.json and src/design/uat-scenario-schema-v1.1-apply.md. Closes #300.'

5. Merge the PR via squash and delete the branch:
   gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch

6. Verify:
   git fetch origin
   git branch -r | grep feature/WF03-GH300-20260810 || echo 'Branch deleted'
   gh issue close 300 --comment 'Resolved by PR #<N> (commit <sha>)'

7. Release the queue lock:
   python3 tools/queue_release.py GH-300 r-co-orchestrator-loop --status RESOLVED

8. Update handoffs/global_queue.json's GH-300 entry: status=RESOLVED, completed_at=current UTC, run_id=WF03-GH300-20260810.

9. After merge, return to main:
   git checkout main
   git pull --ff-only origin main
   git branch --show-current  # must output: main
   git status  # must show clean working tree

10. Run: python3 tools/lint_handoffs.py (must exit 0)

Return PASS once PR is merged, branch deleted, GH-300 closed, queue lock released, and main is clean.
acceptance_criteria: CHANGELOG.md updated with ISS-0085 / GOV-01 entry
PR created on GitHub and merged via squash
Local repo on main with clean working tree
